scenes.heading: Send a short survey after the last session

sents.d: Send a short survey after the last session
The week after a final session is the best chance you get to capture proof and honest feedback.

scenes.heading: Catch it while it is fresh

sents.d: Right after the end, clients remember the whole arc and answer honestly.
A month later you get polite vagueness.
Ask what is different now, what helped most, and what was missing or frustrating.
The praise becomes a testimonial with permission, and the complaints tell you what to fix.

take: Four questions, sent within a week of the final session.
